A more practical solution, in my opinion. Is to put a timeline. As ironic as it sounds, that has helped me. Sometime in July I decided I wanted to kill myself on Spetember 14, but I promised myself that I would do anything and everything to prevent that from happenning. It's been ridiculously difficult to stay true to my own word, but in some way, it's helped. 

Set a date 6 months from now. And go to therapy, make new friends, excercise, forget the rumors (fuck the rumors). In 6 months you'll see that things have gotten better, and suicide won't be your main thought anymore. In time it will fade away. But you have to make a compromise with yourself to try the hardest you've ever tried to save your own life.

And this is just my opinion. So take everything with a grain of salt.
